query:
SELECT 
  DATE_FORMAT(updatedAt, '%Y-%m') as month,
  COUNT(*) as item_count,
  SUM(CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_quantity,
  SUM(CAST(totalSalesValue AS DECIMAL(10,2))) as total_sales_value
FROM inventory
WHERE DATE_FORMAT(updatedAt, '%Y-%m') IN ('2026-05', '2026-06')
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(updatedAt, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month;
